level.description: A mutability level (ADR-0012 decision 1): open (replace, extend and relate), extendable (extend and relate, never replace) or locked (no write).
level.title: Mutability Level

description:
A pack's mutability policy file (policy.yaml at the pack root, ADR-0063), named by the optional mutability_policy key of pack.yaml.

Fields
------
schema_version : int
    The shape's version, the integer 1.
kind_defaults : mapping | absent
    The default level of each artifact kind the pack sets one for, keyed by the
    artifact kind token (ADR-0012 decision 4). A kind left out is open.
artifacts : mapping | absent
    The level of single artifacts, keyed by bare URN (<kind>:<id>, never
    pack-qualified). An entry wins over its kind's default.
role_pins : mapping | absent
    The profile each pinned role is fixed to, keyed by role token, in authored
    order (ADR-0030, ADR-0032 decision 4).

A target's level in one pack is its artifacts entry, else its kind default, else open. Along a composition closure the highest level wins, and a later pack raises a level but never lowers it (ADR-0012 decision 3, ADR-0063 decision 3).

Role pins are declared in role_pins and are tighten-only: two packs of one closure that pin one role to different profiles conflict (role_pin_conflict). Role locks (ADR-0030) stay reserved: the schema is closed, so a roles key, like any key it does not declare, makes the file unreadable, and a pack whose pack.yaml names an unreadable or missing policy file is unreadable.

schema_version.description: The policy shape's version, the integer 1.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

kind_defaults.description: The default level per artifact kind, keyed by the artifact kind token; a kind left out is open.
kind_defaults.title: Kind Defaults

artifacts.description: The level per artifact, keyed by bare URN (<kind>:<id> of an artifact kind, no pack qualifier; a glossary context is glossary_context:<id>, ADR-0053 decision 13); an entry wins over its kind's default.
artifacts.title: Artifacts

role_pins.description: The profile-id each pinned role is fixed to, keyed by role token, in authored order (ADR-0030, ADR-0032 decision 4). The pinned profile is held in the pack's closure and fits the role, as its role or one of its alt-roles. Never the reserved role 'generic' (ADR-0068).
role_pins.title: Role Pins
